title: pipeline/1 — what a pipeline reads, pins, keeps and throws away
description: One pipeline.json at the root of every pipeline (next to AGENTS.md; NOT the web app's file-tree manifest.json). Three places: library/ (reusable, publish with approval), Projects/<CODE>/ (lasting for one project, published by the run), work_dir (temporary, outside public/). Paths in inputs/outputs may use {CODE}; R2 keys are relative to the bucket root; local paths are relative to the work dir unless they start with project:.

agents.description: file the agent reads first, e.g. AGENTS.md

run.description: command that runs the task sheet; {CODE} substituted

kit.description: pipeline_kit version vendored; absent = not on the kit yet

from.description: R2 key pattern (Projects/{CODE}/plan/handoff.json) or project:<file> for files the user puts in the project folder

schema.description: library/Schemas id it must validate against, e.g. canvas.v1

library_pins.description: shared library items this pipeline reads; a run records the exact version/hash used

local_copy.description: pipeline-local copy still in use until phase F removes it

keep.description: published to R2 by the publish stage; everything else stays in the work dir

local.description: glob in the work dir, or project:<file>

to.description: R2 key prefix or full key; {DIR} {OUT} {STEPS} = this pipeline's folder in the project (pipeline_kit.projpaths)

after.description: task id that must be done (and approved, if it is a gate) before this is published

binary.description: large file: R2 keeps only the latest copy, run.json keeps the hash

temp.description: globs in the work dir that are scratch (documentation; anything not in keep is temp anyway)

promotes.description: kinds of reusable items a run may create; reaching library/ needs the user's approval each time
